step1.title: Why Türkiye?
step1.description: Investing in real estate in Turkey gives you access to a market that moves because of real demand, not hype. The country's location, tourism, and young population keep the housing market active all year.
step1.fullDescription: You can find everything from simple city apartments to family projects and coastal homes in places like Istanbul, Antalya, and Bodrum. Foreign buyers also have a clear path to ownership, and some properties offer residency or even citizenship. It's a market with real opportunity, but you still need to understand the basics, because not every area works the same. With proper guidance, Turkey can offer solid long-term value.

step2.title: Prepare and Verify
step2.description: After you pick a property, the first step is making sure all the paperwork is clean. This means checking the title deed, the construction license, and confirming there are no debts on the unit.
step2.fullDescription: Most buyers sign a small reservation or a simple sales agreement and leave a deposit while these checks are done. Having someone experienced look at the documents is important, because missing one small detail can delay the whole purchase. When everything is clear, you can move forward without worry.

step3.title: Complete the Transfer
step3.description: Once the legal checks are finished, the official steps begin. You get a tax number, arrange your payments, and complete the valuation report if needed.
step3.fullDescription: When all documents are ready, you and the seller meet at the Land Registry Office to transfer the title. After the fees and remaining balance are paid, the TAPU is issued in your name. From that moment, the property is officially yours. You can then open the utilities, register the home, and start using it or renting it out right away.

step4.title: Voi Home Has Your Back
step4.description: At Voi Home, we make sure the entire process stays simple and organized. We help you choose the right project, check every document, follow up with developers, and handle the transfer at the Land Registry until you receive your TAPU.
step4.fullDescription: We only work with trusted developers and follow every rule so you don't deal with stress or surprises. With our team beside you, you can buy property in Turkey knowing your time, your money, and your peace of mind are protected.

hero.title: About Voi Home
hero.lead: We check what decides whether a home is worth owning: the paperwork, the building, the neighbors. Only then do we recommend it.

story.title: The story behind Voi Home
story.tagline:
Some agencies sell a property.
We take the time to understand one.
story.paragraph1: A good home reveals itself slowly: the way morning light crosses the kitchen, how the building manager answers the phone, what the street sounds like at eleven at night, whether the title deed is as clean as the listing suggests. Voi Home exists to notice all of it before you have to.
story.paragraph2: We keep our practice deliberately small. Fewer clients means each one is known by name, and fewer homes means each one is known in full: its paperwork, its developer, its neighbors. When we recommend a property, we have already asked the questions you would ask, and a few you would not have thought to.
story.paragraph3: We are rooted in Istanbul and Bodrum and work only in Türkiye. Everything we tell you comes from having walked the street, stood in the rooms and read the documents ourselves.
story.closingLine1: A home is never just a property.
story.closingLine2: Let us show you what we mean.
story.imageAlt: Carved stone facade of a historic building in Istanbul

mission.title: What we stand for
mission.tagline: To know a home as well as the person who will live in it.
mission.description: We take the guesswork out of buying in Türkiye by doing the slow, careful work first. We inspect what others overlook, ask what others skip, and give our clients a clear, honest account of every home we put in front of them.

vision.title: Where we are going
vision.tagline: To be the name people pass on quietly, to the friends they care about most.
vision.description: We would rather be recommended than advertised. Our measure of success is the client who calls us again years later, for a second home or for a friend, because we understood what they were really looking for the first time.

founder.title: About the Founder
founder.description: Samer Al Helwani is a real estate professional with over 15 years of experience, having facilitated property transactions with a collective value exceeding $40 million USD. Trusted by investors, homeowners, and international buyers, he has built his reputation on market expertise, transparency, and a client-first approach. His vision for Voi Home is to make investing in Türkiye simple, secure, and rewarding, by paying attention to the details that matter and providing honest guidance at every stage of the journey.

item1.title: Knowledge first
item1.description: Every recommendation rests on research, on the ground and on paper. We would rather understand a market deeply than follow it loudly.

item2.title: Trust is earned in the details
item2.description: Not through promises, but through telling you the uncomfortable thing early: the missing permit, the optimistic rental estimate, the better home next door.

item3.title: A few homes, well chosen
item3.description: Anyone can show a hundred listings. We would rather show you three that genuinely fit your life, your finances and your plans for the years ahead.

item4.title: One client at a time
item4.description: No two buyers want the same thing, even when they ask for the same thing. We listen for the difference, and build our advice around the person, not the brief.

item5.title: Long after the keys
item5.description: Our work does not end at the title deed office. Furnishing, letting, resale, a second purchase: we intend to be the advisor you return to for all of it.

closing.title: Every detail we check is one less thing you have to wonder about.

faqs.q: Can I buy this home without travelling to Türkiye?
faqs.a: Yes. Many of our clients complete the entire purchase from abroad. We arrange video viewings, a translated review of every document, and a notarized power of attorney, and we stay with you through the title deed transfer and beyond.

faqs.q: Can I arrange a private viewing?
faqs.a: Of course. Viewings are private and unhurried, in person or by live video, at a time that suits you. We will tell you what to look for, and what we have already checked.
We stay involved. Title deed follow-up, utility connections, furnishing, property management and letting are all things we can arrange, so the home is ready when you are.

faqs.q: How do I know this home is right for me?
faqs.a: Tell us how you plan to use it: to live in, to spend summers in, to let, or to secure citizenship. We will give you an honest view, including when a different home would serve you better.

faqs.q: Can you recommend homes that are not listed here?
faqs.a: Often, yes. We hear of homes before they reach the market. Share your budget and priorities, and we will come back to you with a short, considered list.

faqs.q: How do I speak with someone?
faqs.a: Call, message us on WhatsApp, or write to us. You will speak with an advisor directly, never a call center, and usually within the hour.
